🎬🎥**CASTING CALL**🎬🎥

— THE SITE PILOT EPISODE
A COLD UP NORTH FILMS PRODUCTION
📅 FRIDAY 18TH SEPTEMBER 2026
⏰ 2PM–7PM
📍 THE CLEVELAND HOTEL, CRUMPSALL, MANCHESTER, M8
🎥 ABOUT THE SITE
The Site is a new crime comedy-drama set in Manchester and the North of England, following the Cash family, a travelling family balancing their traditional way of life with the wider community around them.
A diverse, character-driven story featuring crime, comedy, drama and everyday situations, with strong Northern characters and plenty of unexpected twists.
We're looking for actors who can deliver both comedy and serious drama, as well as performers from all backgrounds.
🔞 RATED 15 — Contains strong language, scenes of a violent nature and mature themes.
🎭 ROLES
👮‍♀️ Female Police Officer — Female, 18–30
💰 Tommy Cash Jr — Male, 18–30
👩 Ellie Cash — Female, 18–30
👩 Bernie Cash — Female, 40–50
🔪 Local Street Villains x2 — Male, 18–30
🤝 Charlie, Simo's Right-Hand Man — Male, 25–35
🎪 SITE CHARACTERS — Boys & girls, 16–30
🎬 EXTRAS — All ages & backgrounds
🇮🇪 IRISH ACCENT?
Can you do a convincing Irish accent? Not essential, but appreciated for certain roles.
🎬 OPEN AUDITION — JUST TURN UP!
No application needed. Come along on the day and audition.
🪪 Please bring identification.
Anyone under 16 must attend with an appropriate adult.
Previous acting experience isn't essential — we're looking for new talent, experienced actors and people with the right personality for the roles.
🎥 THE SITE
Written & Directed by Brian Walters
Filmed by Rush Walker
Archie Valerio
A Cold Up North Films Production
🔥 CASTING NOW OPEN
THE CASHES. THEIR FAMILY. THEIR COMMUNITY. THEIR WAY OF LIFE.
CRIME • COMEDY • DRAMA • REAL LIFE.

**NORWEGIAN AURA CASTING AUDITIONS**
**NON-UNION**

Norwegian Cruise Line is currently seeking **Production Dancers, Singers, Specialty Vocalists, and Aerialists** for original mainstage productions debuting aboard the newest vessel, the Norwegian AURA.

The AURA will feature a brand-new concert/Las Vegas residency-style production centered around the musical legacy of Whitney Houston, following in the footsteps of *Revolution: A Celebration of Prince* aboard Norwegian AQUA and *Elton: A Celebration of Elton John* aboard Norwegian LUNA. Cast members may also participate in and/or cover other entertainment offerings including Welcome Aboard Shows, nightclub events, parties, and other experiences.

PRODUCTION DANCERS — LOS ANGELES

**Saturday, September 19, 2026**
**OPEN CALL — NO PRE-REGISTRATION REQUIRED**

**Mihran K. Studios**
135 N Victory Blvd
Burbank, CA 91502

Sign-in: **9:30 AM**
Audition begins: **10:00 AM**

Talent will be seen in the order in which they arrive. **Callbacks will be held the same afternoon.**

Female-identifying performers should be prepared to dance in both **heels and flats**. Male-identifying dancers should bring **sneakers and jazz shoes**. Please bring a hard copy headshot and resume. All dancers should wear form-fitting dance attire and be prepared to learn multiple combinations.

Seeking athletic, dynamic, versatile dancers with a strong technical foundation and training in a wide range of styles spanning commercial jazz, contemporary, hip-hop, and more. The ability to partner and lift or be lifted is a must. Strong performance quality, audience engagement, and storytelling are essential. Tumbling/acro is a plus, and certain dancers will be trained in various aerial skills during the rehearsal process. **All ethnicities. Singing is not required. Must be 18+.**

**DANCERS: $1,000/week ($4,350/month) onboard**

**Full Los Angeles audition information:**
[https://nclhcreativestudios.com/2026_auditions/losangeles_aura_sept2026.html](https://nclhcreativestudios.com/2026_auditions/losangeles_aura_sept2026.html)

SINGERS & SPECIALTY VOCALISTS — LOS ANGELES

**Sunday, September 20, 2026**
**BY APPOINTMENT ONLY **

Seeking Production Singers and Specialty Vocalists. Specialty Vocalists should be seasoned vocalist entertainers with strong pop, gospel and R&B backgrounds, while Production Singers should be charismatic performers with strong contemporary pop, rock and R&B skills, tight harmonies, and the ability to move or dance well.

**Specialty Vocalists: $1,730/week ($7,500/month)**
**Singers: $1,200/week ($5,200/month)**

To be considered for an appointment, submit through Breakdown Services, Actors Access, or the audition link below. Selected applicants will receive audition location, time, and additional details by email.

**Full Los Angeles audition information & submission:**
[https://nclhcreativestudios.com/2026_auditions/losangeles_aura_sept2026.html](https://nclhcreativestudios.com/2026_auditions/losangeles_aura_sept2026.html)

AERIALISTS — LAS VEGAS

**Tuesday, September 22, 2026**
**BY INVITATION ONLY **

Seeking athletic, dynamic, versatile gymnasts/acrobats and aerial artists with expertise in skills including **Silks, Straps, Bungee, Cube, Hand Balancing, and Acro/tumbling**. Strong upper-body strength and physical presence are required. Dance training and an understanding of body lines and positions are a major plus. The ability to engage an audience, embody a character, and tell a story is essential.

**Aerialists: $1,350/week ($5,850/month) onboard**

Pre-registration is required. To be considered for an appointment, submit through the link below. Selected applicants will receive the audition location, time, and additional details by email. **Male and female identifying. All ethnicities. Must be 18+.**

**Full Las Vegas audition information & submission:**
[https://nclhcreativestudios.com/2026_auditions/lasvegas_aura_sept2026.html](https://nclhcreativestudios.com/2026_auditions/lasvegas_aura_sept2026.html)

NOW CASTING: My Brother, Marvin

Hi everyone! UNC School of the Arts is now casting for the Fourth Year Thesis Film: My Brother, Marvin.

When Angela learns that her brother, Marvin, who attends a PWI, has developed a mindset of self-hatred that manifests itself as zombieism, she must figure out how to reignite his love for black culture before it’s too late.

Director: Olivia L. Stallworth 

Producer: Mercy Kinsey 

Casting Director: Kyra Muller 

CONTACT: 

If you are interested please send over your name, headshot and preferred role to mybrothermarvincasts@gmail.com

INTEREST DEADLINE: September 23rd 2026

UNCSA 4th Year Project

Non-Union - Unpaid

Bright Star Touring Theatre, the nation’s largest provider of theatre for youth audiences, is currently seeking an Indigenous actor for our 2-person national tour. We are accepting performers of all gender identities for a tour that includes the shows: “Peter Pan”, “Cherokee Tales”, and “The Pirate of Bully Bay”.

This is a paid opportunity, including a compensated rehearsal period, with travel and lodging provided for the duration of the contract. Rehearsal begins in Raleigh, NC on October 4th, and the tour runs through November 24th. Compensation is set at $500/week, including the lodging and tour vehicle.

Applicants should have professional theatre training and experience (a theatre degree is preferable), a valid driver's license, as well as a clean driving and criminal record. We are currently only accepting applicants who are 21 or older. We are looking for strong character actors who are self motivated, independent, and want to travel to exciting, new places!

Please submit your headshot, resume, and availability to hunter@brightstartheatre.com to be considered. We will be conducting virtual auditions on an ongoing basis.

1. Czas nagrania - 1 godzina. Termin i godziny do uzgodnienia. Nagrania są od poniedziałku do piątku.

2. Lokalizacja: Warszawa lub Gdańsk.

3. Zależy nam na dużej różnorodności etnicznej dzieci.

4. Wynagrodzenie za udział dziecka: 300 zł netto (płatne w ciągu 1 dnia po zleceniu — BLIK/konto bankowe).

5. Szukamy pilnie również osoby do szukania takich dzieci o etnicznej urodzie. Wynagrodzenie za znalezienie takiego dziecka, które zostanie zaangażowane do projektu — do uzgodnienia. Prosimy o wiadomość na adres e-mail rekrutacja@agencjainfernal.pl.

W razie zainteresowania prosimy o wysłanie zgłoszenia dziecka, podając następujące informację:

1. Imię i nazwisko

2. Rok urodzenia

3. Miasto zamieszkania

4. Telefon kontaktowy do rodzica

5. Adres e-mail do rodzica

6. Wzrost

7. Na jakie miasto jest wysyłane zgłoszenie dziecka? Na Gdańsk czy Warszawę? Czy na oba miasta?

7. Minimum jedno zdjęcie

Kontakt: rekrutacja@agencjainfernal.pl

CASTING EXTRAS FOR SENIOR THESIS SHORT FILM ‼️‼️‼️

Hello, my name is Elliot Harrington and I am the producer of the upcoming short film called “Sponsored By”. It is about a divorced father who takes on coaching a Little League baseball team in hopes to impress his boss, get a promotion, and be invited to an exclusive BBQ.

Looking for:
- Individuals who read as 4-7 years of age (willing to accept submissions from individuals a few years older than 7)

Shooting Dates:
- September 26th: 10 AM-4 PM
- September 27th: 8 AM-2 PM
- October 3rd: 2 PM-8 PM
- October 4th: 10 AM-4 PM
- October 10th: 2 PM-8 PM 

Shooting Location: Loveland, CO

If you can make it to all these dates, congrats; you are a part of the home baseball team and have the opportunity for lines and more screen time.

If you can’t make it to all the dates and only some, congrats; you are a part of one of the away teams with no lines and less screen time.

Extras are unpaid, but will receive IMDb credit. All minors must have a parent with them present on set 24/7. We need adult extras as well, so instead of parents just sitting around, they have the opportunity to be in the bleachers, cheering on the team.

If you are interested, or know anyone who is interested, please reach out to me with your availability and your headshot. You can message me here or email me @ elliot.m.harrington@gmail.com

Thank you!

Short Film Casting Call!

Title- Roommates 

Logline- A musician riddled with self doubt is more focused on appeasing her overly critical roommate than she is on writing a new song.

**We have the rest of the cast filled except for the two roles posted here. Here is the breakdown for the characters. **

**Jenna (20-28) can be female or non binary- Jenna is Eleanor’s (main character) long time girlfriend who uses her background in psychology to help Eleanor realize how much her anxiety is controlling her. She is Eleanor’s anchor in a storm. Her style is the friendly barista at a hole in the wall coffee shop that you feel like you can open up to even if you just met. **

**Eleanor's Brother (mid to late 20's) can be male, non binary, or trans- The opposite of Eleanor with him having what society calls a “normal job”. He is happy with the life he is making for himself and wants Eleanor to not compare herself to him. He is also quite the gamer wearing his achievements in his online fantasy games like a badge of honor. Enjoys online fantasy gaming, DND style gaming, and LARPING. (Think the male version of Charlie Bradbury from Supernatural).**

**Production is aiming to film in January. **

**Production type- Non union **

**Compensation- TBD determined by funding, meals, I**MDB Credit 

Auditions will close on October 3rd 

Additional information- If cast you must be willing to sign an NDA. This is per the request of myself and the exsecutive producer  as well as our sponsors for the film.

🎭 NOT ALL ACTING TRAINING WILL GET YOU CLOSER TO BOOKING WORK.
And you might not even realise it.

If you’ve been taking acting classes for months or even years, but you’re still struggling with your confidence, technique or ability to apply what you’re learning…

Your teacher might not be the right teacher for you.

⚠️ Here are 3 BIG red flags I’d pay VERY close attention to:

1. You’re performing scenes and receiving criticism, but you’re not being TRAINED to improve.

A teacher can critique your scene every week, but if they aren’t giving you the exercises and techniques to develop your overall ability as an actor, that’s criticism, not training.

2. You’re not seeing meaningful growth in your acting, which is holding you back from becoming the extraordinary actor you’re capable of becoming with the right training.

🚨 3. Your acting teacher has never built a successful working career as an actor: How can you be confident that what you’re being taught will help you BOOK WORK if your teacher has never built a successful career themselves?

These are the kinds of red flags that can make you waste months (and thousands of dollars) on training that isn’t moving you forward.

So I created the FREE Acting Teacher Blueprint.

Inside, I’ll show you exactly what kind of training will help you BOOK WORK, so you don’t waste another dollar or another year on acting training that isn’t advancing you.

👇 Comment TEACHER below and DM me TEACHER.

I’ll send you the Blueprint FREE.

🎬 CASTING-AUFRUF: Vater & Kind-Rolle für Kurzfilm „05:05“ 🎬
Für das experimentelle Kurzfilm-Drama „05:05“ (Regie & Produktion: Ewald Kiricenko / HdM Stuttgart) suchen wir die Besetzung für zwei wichtige Rollen.  

(Hinweis: Die Hauptrolle des 19-jährigen Eren ist bereits besetzt!)  

📌 Projekt-Details:

 Titel: 05:05  

 Format: Experimenteller Kurzfilm (Drama / Social Study)  

 Ausstrahlung: Filmfestivals, MUBI, YouTube  
 Regie & Produktion: Ewald Kiricenko  

 Kontakt / Bewerbung: ewald.kiricenko@gmail.com | Tel.: 0176 21462320  

📖 Logline:
Ein 19-Jähriger hat bis Mitternacht Zeit, sich für eine sichere Zukunft zu bewerben. Doch während sein Vater, Social Media und eine zunehmend vertraute KI ihm erklären, was aus ihm werden soll, muss er entscheiden, ob er sein Leben auf eine Zukunft ausrichten kann, an die er selbst nicht glaubt.  

🎭 Gesuchte Rollen:

1. ONUR / VATER (männlich)

 Spielalter: ca. 45–55 Jahre (Figur ist 47 Jahre alt)  
 Rollenprofil: Erens pragmatischer Vater. Er meint es grundsätzlich gut und sorgt sich ehrlich um die finanzielle Zukunft seines Sohnes („etwas Sicheres/Vernünftiges lernen“), versteht jedoch Erens Wunsch nach einer künstlerischen Laufbahn nicht.  

 Anforderungen: Starke Präsenz, Überzeugungskraft, authentisches Zusammenspiel in emotional geladenen Dialogszenen (Konflikt zwischen elterlicher Fürsorge, Pragmatismus und Unverständnis).  

2. KIND EREN (männlich)

 Spielalter: ca. 9–12 Jahre (Figur in der Rückblende ist ca. 11 Jahre alt)  

 Rollenprofil: Eren als Kind in Rückblenden / Erinnerungsszenen. Ein aufgeweckter, unbeschwerter Junge mit einer natürlichen Begeisterung für das Zeichnen.  

 Anforderungen: Authentisches, pures Kinderlächeln, Freude am Malen/Zeichnen. Kompakter Drehaufwand.  

📩 Bewerbung:

Bitte sendet eure Bewerbung mit dem Betreff „Casting 05:05 – [Rolle: Vater OR Kind Eren]“ an:
📧 ewald.kiricenko@gmail.com

Inhalt der Bewerbung:

 Für die Vater-Rolle: Aktuelle Fotos (Porträt & Ganzkörper), Wohnort, Kontaktdaten sowie Showreel / Arbeitsproben (falls vorhanden).

 Für die Kind-Rolle (durch Erziehungsberechtigte): Name & Alter des Kindes, 2–3 aktuelle Fotos, Wohnort & Kontaktdaten der Eltern.

📄 Weitere Infos zum Visuellen Stil und zur Stimmungs-Welt findet ihr im Pitchdeck hier: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1YSoMOpidVeFM0DwhE_ZnwZwzE-Wa8usT/view?usp=drivesdk

Wir freuen uns sehr auf eure Einsendungen! 🎥✨

Schauspielersuche:
Für den Kurzfilm "AT : Es stand Alles im Wahlprogramm"
sind folgende Rollen zu besetzen 

- Arabisch /Türkischer Mann ca. 20 Jahre alt
-Arabisch / Türkischer Mann ca 50 - 60 Jahre alt
- Deutscher Mann ca. 27 Jahre alt
-Arabisch / Türkische Frau ca. 27 Jahre alt
- Deutscher Mann ca 45 Jahre alt
- Deutsche Frau, blond, ca 45 Jahre alt

Filminhalt :
Ein rechtradikaler Politiker sonnt sich nach einer Wahl  in seinem Erfolg.
Aber die Fassade bröckelt. Eine bittere  Politsatire. 

Aufgrund des aktuellen Bezuges sollte der Dreh schnell erfolgen, daher kann jeder Schauspieler seine Rolle am Laptop oder Smartphone selber Filmen. 
Der Film soll dann kostenfrei auf you Tube gestellt werden und jeder kann den Film sofort nutzen. Es geht darum den Film zu verbreiten, daher auch leider keine Bezahlung,  da kein Geld verdient werden kann. 
Ich hoffe es finden sich Schauspieler, die sich gegen den Rechtsradikalismus stellen und Charakter zeigen.

Ich bin Thomas Goersch,  Schauspieler und Filmregisseur www.imdb.com/name/nm1591928
Meldet Euch unter Thomas.Goersch@vodafonemail.de 
Bis dann
Thomas

ALL ROLES FILLED NO MORE APPLICATIONS PLEASE ‼️‼️

🎬 EXTRAS WANTED FOR AN UPCOMING FEATURE FILM! 🎬

We’re looking for people to come and be part of an exciting feature film called “Hi Honey” !An award-winning director attached! ⭐️

We need a variety of people for different scenes across West London, whether you’ve never been on a film set before or you’re looking to get some experience, we’d love to hear from you! 🎥

📅 22/09– HAYES�🏢 Boardroom / office scene�👥 10 extras needed�🔞 Ages 25+�⏰ Half day

📅 23/09 & 24/09 – EALING�💍 Two wedding scenes + one funeral scene�👥 20+ extras needed�👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 All ages welcome�⏰ Full days�⚠️ Must be available for BOTH days

📅 25/09– FULHAM�🪑 Support group scene�👥 All ages�⏰ Half day

💰 PLEASE NOTE: THESE ARE UNPAID EXTRA ROLES.

We know everyone’s time is valuable, so we want to be completely transparent about that from the start. There’s no payment for these roles, but it’s a great chance to spend time on a professional feature film set, meet a brilliant cast & crew, gain important connections and hopefully have a fun day being part of the filmmaking process! 🎬🙌

If interested: �Drop a text to 07565418028 with:�📸 A recent photo�👤 Your name & age�📅 Which date(s) you can do�📞 Your contact details

Please share this post with anyone you think might be interested! Come be part of our movie!

Hello everyone!! I’m the writer and director of an upcoming short film ‘Hey Lizzie’

Pre production is well underway for this project and we are now onto the casting!! 

The production will be based in Preston, Lancashire and looking to cast local talent

For any and all information visit our instagram page @heylizzieshortfilm

From our script ranting production team we look forward to seeing all your amazing talent!!

items.text:
🎬 THE BROS SHOW — FINAL AUDITION CALL-UP
You have been officially called up for The Bros Show auditions. 🎥

📅 Date: Saturday, 19 September 2026

🕙 Arrival / Registration: 10:00 AM — mandatory

🎭 Auditions: From 10:00 AM onwards

🕟 Expected audition finish: 4:30 PM

🗣️ Final decisions: 4:30–5:00 PM

🔒 Closing time: 5:00 PM

📍 Venue:

Minet Library

52 Knatchbull Road

London

🎭 What the audition involves

The auditions will involve the team testing how well you can bring your character to life.

You may be asked to:

* Perform from a The Bros Show script

* Improvise as your character

* React naturally to different situations

* Show the character’s personality, emotions and comedic timing

* Adapt to different directions during the audition

We are looking for actors who can actually play the character, not simply read the lines.

🎬 Who makes the final decisions?

After the auditions, Aweys, Callum and Abdi will have a private discussion from approximately 4:30–5:00 PM to decide who makes it through.

💰 Production

This is an unpaid independent production.

Actors who are selected will receive production credit and the opportunity to appear in The Bros Show. Refreshments may also be provided during production.

👨‍👩‍👧 Under 17s

If you are under 17, please make sure your parent/guardian is aware of and gives permission for your participation before accepting a role.

📱 If you’re selected

Once you officially receive a role, you will be added to the The Bros Show WhatsApp group chat.

From there, we’ll coordinate:

🎬 Shooting dates

📍 Locations

📋 Scripts/scenes

🎭 Character details

🎥 Production plans

We are currently looking at getting Episodes 5, 6 and 7 recorded soon, so selected cast members should be prepared for upcoming filming dates.

⚠️ IMPORTANT

Please arrive at 10:00 AM.

Check-in instructions will be sent to you by text and explained again when you arrive at the audition.

Good luck — and remember…

🎬 TRUST THE VISION. 🗿

topComments.text: Just checking you’re aware of the licensing requirements if you cast someone currently in Year 11 or younger, since you mentioned under 17s. You would need to apply for a license for them in plenty of time and have a chaperone present on set. Apologies if you’re already aware, just wouldn’t want you to jeopardise your production if not.
Absolutely insane, a full day audition for an unpaid role

Schauspielersuche:
Für den Kurzfilm "AT : Es stand Alles im Wahlprogramm"
sind folgende Rollen zu besetzen 

- Arabisch /Türkischer Mann ca. 20 Jahre alt
-Arabisch / Türkischer Mann ca 50 - 60 Jahre alt
- Deutscher Mann ca. 27 Jahre alt
-Arabisch / Türkische Frau ca. 27 Jahre alt
- Deutscher Mann ca 45 Jahre alt
- Deutsche Frau, blond, ca 45 Jahre alt

Filminhalt :
Ein rechtradikaler Politiker sonnt sich nach einer Wahl  in seinem Erfolg.
Aber die Fassade bröckelt. Eine bittere  Politsatire. 

Aufgrund des aktuellen Bezuges sollte der Dreh schnell erfolgen, daher kann jeder Schauspieler seine Rolle am Laptop oder Smartphone selber Filmen. 
Der Film soll dann kostenfrei auf you Tube gestellt werden und jeder kann den Film sofort nutzen. Es geht darum den Film zu verbreiten, daher auch leider keine Bezahlung,  da kein Geld verdient werden kann. 
Ich hoffe es finden sich Schauspieler, die sich gegen den Rechtsradikalismus stellen und Charakter zeigen.

Ich bin Thomas Goersch,  Schauspieler und Filmregisseur www.imdb.com/name/nm1591928
Meldet Euch unter Thomas.Goersch@vodafonemail.de 
Bis dann
Thomas

Hey Leute, für einen Dreh am 19.09 - 20.09.26 für unser Low Budget Fantasy Horror Großprojekt. Suchen wir noch einen männlichen Darsteller, Rolle: Schwarzer Ritter (mit Dialog). Gedreht wird im Bayerischen Wald, 94258 Frauenau. Bewerbung mit 2-3 aktuellen Bildern von euch, gerne auch mit einem kurzen Vorstellungsvideo, sowie eurer Körpergröße, Kleidergröße und Schuhgröße, an harlekin-filme@web.de oder an Harlekin Filme 

Viele Grüße von eurem Harlekin Filme Team

Casting Call
Ich bin Thomas Goersch ein nicht reicher, ein nicht berühmter Filmregisseur aus Deutschland.  
Schaut das Video und vielleicht wollt Ihr in meinem Film mitspielen. 
www.imdb.com/name/nm1591928
Meldet Euch auf Thomas.Goersch@vodafonemail.de 
Lieben Dank 
Thomas

PS: inzwischen gibt es auch einen Filminhalt und es ergeben sich daraus verschiedene Rollen:

- Arabisch /Türkischer Mann ca. 20 Jahre alt
-Arabisch / Türkischer Mann ca 50 - 50 Jahre alt
- Deutscher Mann ca. 27 Jahre alt
-Arabisch / Türkische Frau ca. 27 Jahre alt
- Deutscher Mann ca 45 Jahre alt
- Deutsche Frau, blond, ca 45 Jahre alt

items.text:
Z początkiem października 
Ruszamy że zdjęciami do kolejnych odcinków TRUDNE SPRAWY.
Zdjęcia odbędą się między 1-5 Październikiem 
UWAGA. Są to jedne z ostatnich odcinków przed realizacyjną przerwą.
Także może to być ostatni gwizdek aby zagrać w tym roku.

 Postacie do obsadzenia:

1. Zosia 
Wiek 20-25 lat.
Jest to główna rola, także proszę osoby z dużym doświadczeniem na planie 
Terminy zdjęć 1.2.3 Październik 

2. Kinga wiek około 48 lat
Jest to pierwszoplanowa rola także proszę osoby z dużym doświadczeniem na planie 
Terminy zdjęć 1.2.3 Październik 

3.Agata wiek około 23 lal
Duża rola. Proszę osoby z doświadczeniem na planie.
Terminy zdjęć 1.2.3 Październik 

4. Kurier wiek pomiedzy 25-35 lat 
Proszę osoby z Wrocławia lub okolic 
Terminy zdjęć 2 Październik

5. Ilona wiek około 55 lat 
Proszę osoby z Wrocławia i okolic.
Terminy zdjęć 3 Październik 

6. Pani Lusia wiek pomiedzy 60-70 lat
Proszę osoby z Wrocławia i okolic.
Terminy zdjęć 3 Październik 

7. Piękna kobieta wiek pomiedzy 30-40 lat
Proszę tylko osoby z doświadczeniem na planie.
Terminy zdjęć. 1 oraz 3 Październik 

8. Michalina około 35 lat 
Jest to główna rola, także proszę osoby z dużym doświadczeniem na planie 
Terminy zdjęć: 3,4,5 Październik 

10 Teresa około 65 lat  
Proszę tylko osoby z doświadczeniem na planie.
Terminy zdjęć 4,5 Październik 

11. Eryk wiek pomiedzy 60-70 lat 
Wygląd: Przystojny.
Proszę tylko osoby z doświadczeniem na planie.
Terminy zdjęć 3,4,5 Październik.

12. Krzysztof około 40 lat
Wygląd: Przystojny 
Rola prawnik 
Terminy zdjęć: 3,4,5 Październik 

13. Elżbieta około 65 lat 
Proszę tylko osoby z Wrocławia lub okolic 
Terminy zdjęć 3 oraz 5 Październik 

14. Koleżanka około 35 lat 
Proszę tylko osoby z Wrocławia lub okolic.
Terminy zdjęć 3,4 Październik 

15  Klient między 40 a 60 lat 
Proszę tylko osoby z Wrocławia lub okolic.
Terminy zdjęć 3 Październik 

16. Sąsiad między 50 a 66 lat 
Proszę tylko osoby z Wrocławia lub okolic.
Terminy zdjęć 3 Październik 

17. Sąsiadka między 50 a 70 lat 
Proszę tylko osoby z Wrocławia lub okolic.
Terminy zdjęć 3 Październik 

Wynagrodzenie płatne gotówką na planie po zakończeniu zdjęć. Zdjęcia odbędą się we Wrocławiu, a dla osób spoza Wrocławia zwracam koszty podróży oraz zapewniam hotel.

Osoby zainteresowane historią odcinka, wynagrodzeniem oraz informacją jak wziąć udział w castingu zapraszam do kontaktu na priv, bądź komentarz pod postem :)

Zgłoszenia można również wysyłać na emial adres 
adrian.zarzecki@polotmedia.pl z informacją wiek, jakie doświadczenie na planie, aktualne zdjęcia i numer tel.

Do zobaczenia na planie ;)

🎬 ADULT SCREEN ACTING CLASSES – MANCHESTER 🎬

Want to improve your acting for camera, build your confidence, and get more experience working on screen?

Scene 2 Screen Adult Screen Acting Classes are held every Monday & Tuesday, 7pm–9pm in Manchester and are open to ALL LEVELS — whether you're completely new to acting or already have experience.

🎥 What we cover:�
• Acting for camera�
• Script analysis�
• Self-tape techniques�
• Building confidence on screen
• Industry insight & advice�
• Working with professional scripts

We also regularly bring in industry professionals, including casting directors and directors, for specialist workshops, plus regular agent panels giving you the opportunity to gain valuable insight into the industry.

⭐ BUT HERE'S WHAT REALLY SETS US APART…
Twice during every 4-week block, we film showreel-quality scenes with our students.
You don't just do the scene and forget about it — you get the finished footage to keep and use for your showreel, social media, casting profiles and personal promotion. 🎥

And all of this for just £85 for a 4-week block.

Whether you're looking to get into acting, return to it, sharpen your skills or simply have a go at something new, you'll find a friendly, inclusive and welcoming environment at Scene 2 Screen.

🎬 Monday & Tuesday | 7pm–9pm�📍 Manchester�🎭 All levels welcome�💷 £85 for 4 weeks

📩 Email: Sceen2screenMCR@Gmail.com

#Scene2Screen #ScreenActing #ActingClasses #ManchesterActors #ManchesterActing #AdultActingClasses #ActingForCamera #SelfTape #Showreel #Manchester #Actors #ActingWorkshop

Kollektiv is a booking, payment and management platform built for Berlin’s independent creative scene—from DJs and tattoo artists to photographers, designers, performers and collectives.

With one public link, people can discover your work, book services or events and pay without creating an account. Creators manage bookings, income, collaborator splits, guest lists, secret locations and German-compliant invoices from one simple dashboard.

Built in Berlin. Made for the scene. 🖤💚

Discover Kollektiv:
[https://kollektiv-link-studio.lovable.app](https://kollektiv-link-studio.lovable.app/)

Built in Berlin. Made for the scene. 🖤💚

I am a filmmaker working on Indendent Shortmovies to present on many international filmfestivals all around the word.

I am starting next the second shooting part of my my next movie.

40 actors are telling one story in a Video Chat. 
Every actor with 2-3 sentences. Every actor is shooting on his own with his smart phone. It would be perfect to have a great mixture from serveral countries.
Please watch at my imdb side to know more about me.
www.imdb.com/name/nm1591928
Every actor will get a credit on imdb and for sure in the movie.

Best Thomas Goersch

AURELLE MODEL MANAGEMENT
International New Face Casting

AURELLE Model Management is currently scouting distinctive female talent aged 18–28 for potential representation and future opportunities within the international fashion industry.

We are looking for individuals with strong presence, individuality and the confidence to bring something unique to the fashion world. We welcome applications from diverse ethnicities, cultures, body types, heights, skin tones, hair textures, facial structures and personal styles.

At AURELLE, difference is not a disadvantage. Your individuality, authenticity and personal identity are what make you memorable.

If you are interested in being considered, please send an email to:

[aurellemodel@gmail.com](mailto:aurellemodel@gmail.com)

Please include:
* Full name
* Age
* Current city and country
* Contact number
* Instagram or social-media profile
* Height
* A brief introduction about yourself
* Recent natural photographs or digitals, including a clear portrait and full-length image

Please ensure that all information submitted is accurate and that photographs are recent, clear and free from heavy filters.

Please arrange to be available for an online callback audition ONLY IF you are selected and notified via email.

All models under the age of 21 must be accompanied during the audition by a parent or legal guardian.

Submitting an application does not guarantee selection or representation. Only selected applicants will be contacted via email.

AURELLE MODEL MANAGEMENT
London | International Talent Scouting

Different is the standard.

🎬 ISO: COSTUME DESIGNER — LOW-BUDGET INDEPENDENT FILM 👗🎥

I’m looking for a Costume Designer to join a low-budget independent film production in Los Angeles. 🌴

Looking for someone who can help develop the characters’ wardrobe and overall visual style, source/organize costumes, and work with the director to achieve the look of the film. 🎨👔

Looking for:
✨ Costume design experience preferred, but emerging designers are welcome
🧵 Creative and resourceful with a low-budget approach
🤝 Able to collaborate with a small independent production team
📍 Must be based in Los Angeles / LA area

This is a small independent production, so I’m especially interested in people who enjoy creative problem-solving and building a strong visual style with limited resources. 🎭

📣 CASTING – POSZUKUJEMY MĘŻCZYZNY 50–75LAT 📣

Do promocyjnego filmu towarzyszącego wydarzeniu kulturalnemu poszukujemy mężczyzny w wieku 50–75 lat do roli RYBAKA 🎣

Szukamy osoby z naturalną energią, otwartością, pogodnym usposobieniem i radością życia. Mile widziane jest zamiłowanie do wędkowania lub doświadczenie w łowieniu ryb, ale nie jest to warunek konieczny. Najważniejsza jest dla nas autentyczność, swoboda i naturalność przed kamerą.

🎬 Nagrania: jutro, w pierwszej połowie dnia

⏱️ Czas pracy: ok. 3 godziny

💰 Wynagrodzenie: 100 zł

Jeśli jesteś zainteresowany lub znasz kogoś, kto idealnie pasuje do tego opisu, zostaw komentarz pod postem lub napisz do nas wiadomość prywatną.

Będziemy również bardzo wdzięczni za udostępnienie ogłoszenia – może właśnie dzięki Tobie znajdziemy naszego bohatera! 🎣

🎬 HEUTE UM 18 UHR! 🎬

Unser kleiner Film „Ein Tag mit BEYOND OBSESSION“ feiert heute Abend Premiere! 🖤

Begleitet uns einen Tag lang – mit Live-Momenten, Interviews und Einblicken hinter die Kulissen.

📺 Heute, 18:00 Uhr auf YouTube!

Ein Riesen-Dankeschön an die gesamte TM Studio Film Crew für diese fantastische Arbeit! 🖤
Danke an Tom und sein Team, dass ihr diesen besonderen Tag mit uns festgehalten und daraus diesen tollen Film gemacht habt. 🙏

Vielen lieben Dank auch an Josie(jophiel Photogaphy), die uns an diesem Tag fotografisch begleitet und viele schöne Momente festgehalten hat. 📸🖤

Und natürlich ein großes Dankeschön an René (Lucy-Fairs Garden)für die Einladung und dafür, dass dieser besondere Tag überhaupt möglich war! 🙏🖤

Seid dabei – wir freuen uns auf euch! 🖤

#BeyondObsession #EinTagMitBeyondObsession #Premiere #YouTube #NewWave DarkPop @lucyfairsgarden @jophiel_photography

🎥 Montaż demo aktorskiego z konsultacją 

Potrzebujesz demo aktorskiego, które pokaże Twój talent aktorski i wszechstronność a jednocześnie będzie zgodne z aktualnymi wymogami reżyserów castingu? Chcesz dowiedzieć się jak pobierać materiały i jak tworzyć takie demo samemu w przyszłości w łatwy sposób oraz jak zwiększyć swoje szanse na konkretną role? Jeżeli tak to zapraszam do skorzystania z mojej usługi 🙂 

✅ dokładnie przejrzę Twoje aktorskie materiały, wybiorę najlepsze aktorsko sceny oraz różnorodne pod względem emocji i ról

✅ zmontuję demo zgodnie z aktualnymi wymogami reżyserów castingu uwzględniając również to, które sceny Ty uważasz za najlepsze 

✅ podczas konsultacji opowiem Ci o obecnych standardach montażu i doboru scen, dam dużo cennych rad abyś mogła / mógł w przyszłości montować demo samodzielnie 

✅ gotowe demo dostaniesz ode mnie maksymalnie w 2 dni od wysłania mi swoich materiałów

✅ przystępna cena 💵 szczegóły na priv 

Na zdjęciach załączam jedną z wiadomość od klienta po moim montażu 🔥💪 

Uwaga! Nie zajmuję się pobieraniem materiałów.

🎨✨ SZTUKA SAMOEKSPRESJI — POKAŻ ŚWIATU TO, CO MASZ W SOBIE! ✨🎨

Sztuka to jeden z najpiękniejszych sposobów wyrażania emocji, charakteru, marzeń i własnego spojrzenia na świat. Każdy twórca mówi innym językiem — poprzez muzykę, taniec, obraz, słowo, fotografię czy scenę. 🌟

Zapraszamy do udziału w II Międzynarodowym Konkursie Sztuki „SZTUKA SAMOEKSPRESJI” — wydarzeniu dla wszystkich, którzy chcą rozwijać swoją pasję, prezentować talent i zdobywać nowe artystyczne doświadczenia. 🎭🎶💃🖌️

📅 Przyjmowanie zgłoszeń: od 19.09 do 03.10.

💻 Uczestnictwo odbywa się w formule zdalnej, dlatego możesz wziąć udział niezależnie od miejsca zamieszkania — wygodnie i bez konieczności podróżowania. 🌍

Na uczestników czekają:

🌈 bez ograniczeń wiekowych;
🎤 wszystkie nominacje i gatunki;
📜 dyplomy i listy podziękowania;
🏅 medale;
🏆 puchary.

💛 Wyjątkowy koszt uczestnictwa — tylko 35 PLN!

Nie bój się pokazać własnego stylu. Nie trzeba tworzyć tak jak inni — właśnie indywidualność, emocje i autentyczność sprawiają, że sztuka staje się wyjątkowa. ✨

Niech ten konkurs będzie okazją do zaprezentowania swojej pracy, zdobycia kolejnego osiągnięcia i przypomnienia sobie, że twórczość nie ma jednego właściwego kierunku. Najważniejsze, aby była naprawdę Twoja. ❤️

🌐 Dodatkowe informacje i warunki uczestnictwa:

Organizator — Ogólnopolska Agencja Sztuki 2G.

🎨🌟 „SZTUKA SAMOEKSPRESJI” — twórz po swojemu, wyrażaj siebie i pozwól, aby Twoja sztuka została zauważona!

CASTING CALL — Florida & Surrounding States
DEFIANCE
Non-Union, Paid Roles
Filming in Florida: January 29 – February 17, 2027
From 3 Rats Entertainment, the team behind Killer Grannies, Bad Bunny, Extortion Thugs, The American Ripper, Snarly Yow, and Amityville: Mt. Misery Road, comes a new historical feature.
Florida, December 28, 1835. Major Francis L. Dade leads over 100 U.S. soldiers north toward Fort King through Florida's wilderness, unaware that warriors are watching their every move. Within hours, the encounter will erupt into one of the most consequential battles in Florida history, helping ignite the Second Seminole War.
Now Casting
We are seeking performers throughout Florida and surrounding states for the following roles:
Women to play historical settlers
Men to play soldiers
Experience with period flintlock muskets, historical reenactment, horseback riding, wilderness skills, or combat performance is a plus, but not required.
How to Submit
Send submissions to Karolina & Flor, Casting Directors — 3 Rats Entertainment
Email: 3ratsentertainment@gmail.com
Please include:
Several current photographs
Acting or reenactment experience
Film credits, if applicable
Flintlock musket experience, if applicable
Horseback riding experience, if applicable
Current city and state
Please share this casting call.

We are excited to announce our next 4-week Hollyoaks Adult Acting Course starting this November for actors aged 16+. For the very first time, we will have both Hollyoaks Casting Directors—Peter Hunt and Gill Charnock—in together to watch your performances.
During the final week on 6th December, participants will take part in a mock casting in front of Peter and Gill. They will be giving notes, feedback, and direction on each individual performance. items.text:
CASTING CALL – “ALONE” | Independent Short Film

We are casting the lead role for Alone, an independent short film set in the present day and the past.

The film follows a young man who wakes alone in a car park with no memory of how he got there, gradually trying to piece together what has happened.

Role: Male lead
Playing age: 20–30
Experience: Previous acting experience is welcome but absolutely not essential.

The role will involve some physical performance, so applicants should be comfortable with this. Further details will be provided before filming.

Filming will take place over one full day at several locations in/around North Wiltshire. The exact filming date will be agreed with the successful actor once availability has been discussed.

This is currently an unpaid independent production although lunch will be provided. [Unfortunately, we are unable to cover travel expenses.]

[The successful actor will receive a copy of the finished film and footage suitable for use in a showreel.]

To apply, please email hg.film.creations@gmail.com with the subject: Alone – Short Film Application

Please include:

- A recent headshot/photo
- Your age
- Your location
- Any relevant acting experience (although no previous experience is required)

Shortlisted applicants will be sent a short extract from the script and asked to record a brief self-tape audition.

Thank you — I look forward to hearing from you.

topComments.text: If you can't cover travel as a minimum dude you shouldn't be making a film. Actors at the very least shouldn't be out of pocket to work.

🎭 Actors / Beginners welcome

If you’re interested and serious about getting involved, send me a message or call me on 07425 952701.

Its that time again....

Auditions (self tapes) are now open for 'Benji jnr' and "Benji's mum". 

The cycle is a short film based around a young man struggling to break the cycle of generational and childhood trauma and the challenges he faces. 

The film is the second film of Tori Hughes, who's first film 'The Aftermath' is an award winning film and currently doing the festival circuit. 

See slides for roles, dates and details.

Please be aware that roles are currently expenses only however fundraising is ongoing and so this may change given budget. Film will be entered into the festival circuit and is built to raise awareness of themes involved. 

Please message myself, Claire Ward   or Sarah Elizabeth if you wish to self tape. We look forward to watching!

Deadline is 20th September.

**FINAL WEEKS OF CASTING!! BIG PERSONALITIES WANTED FOR A NEW PRISON ESCAPE COMPETITION SERIES**

Do you have what it takes to survive the pressure, outsmart the competition, endure the relentless realities of prison life, and ultimately find a way out?

An exciting new reality competition series is searching nationwide for bold, skilled, and charismatic individuals ready to test their limits in a one-of-a-kind social and survival experiment.

Contestants will live, compete, and survive inside a real decommissioned prison that has been transformed for this extraordinary challenge. Cut off from the comforts of everyday life, they'll face the harsh realities of a prison environment 24 hours a day—from cramped living conditions and constant surveillance to the mental strain of confinement and the social dynamics that come with it. As they navigate intense physical challenges, high-pressure mental tests, and strategic gameplay, they'll work toward one ultimate goal: escape.

Every decision matters. Every relationship has consequences. And only those who can outlast, outthink, outmaneuver—and endure—the competition will have a chance at victory.

**We're looking for people who:**
* Have larger-than-life personalities
* Are highly competitive and strategic
* Can handle demanding physical and mental challenges
* Can endure the stress, discipline, and psychological pressures of living in a prison environment 24/7
* Possess a **unique talent, skill set, or area of expertise **that could give them an edge in the game
* Thrive under pressure and adapt quickly to changing circumstances

**Apply now and prove you have the brains, grit, resilience, and determination to survive prison life, escape—and win $100,000.**

APPLY NOW: [https://prisonescape.castingcrane.com/](https://prisonescape.castingcrane.com/)

PAID CASTING: Female Lead/Co Star | Music Video | Toronto / GTA
Casting a female lead (playing age 19–27) for a cinematic pop/R&B music video filming in the GTA one day between Sept 26-Oct 5 (exact date TBD).

Concept: A darkly playful relationship visual centered around a chess game, exploring gaslighting, hypocrisy and double standards. The female character is confident and self-assured and genuinely believes she is being reasonable, even as the male lead becomes increasingly frustrated. Looking for someone who can communicate disbelief, defensiveness, irritation and “you’re overreacting” energy through subtle facial expressions and eye contact.

• Rate: $150 CAD flat

• Time: Approx. 3–4 hours

• Location: GTA, exact location TBD

• Union: Non-union

• Physicality: No kissing, sexual content or romantic physicality required.

Acting/on-camera experience is preferred but newer performers with strong camera presence are welcome.

To apply: DM me here or on IG @thelinkstrummer with your name, age/playing age, current photos, general GTA location, and any acting reel/on-camera footage if available. Thanks!

items.text:
Aspiring/Beginner Actors: Are you looking for some screen acting guidance and mentorship?🎬🌟

Hi, I’m Emma! I’m an Actress and Screen Acting Mentor based in the UK, and I am the founder of Take Two Acting. I have been involved in many productions for companies such as the BBC, Channel 4, Manchester Film School, SAE Liverpool and more.

I also work alongside another actor, Elena Pitsiaeli, who is known for “The Little Big Things” on the West End, CBBC’s Horrible Histories and many others!

The aim of the sessions is to give guidance on beginner screen actors who want tips on screen acting techniques and feedback on auditions, self tapes or monologues! Our sessions are casual and informal, and are completely tailored to the individual and their level.

All our lessons are online so open to actors from around the world! 

Before booking a session, we offer a FREE 10 min consultation, either by video call or phone. This is an opportunity for us to meet and discuss what you would want out of a session, and how we can best help you.

If you decide after the consultation you would like to book an online session, this can be arranged at a time that suits you!

Please message me if you’re interested in booking a free consultation, or simply want to know more about how we can help you☺️

Instagram: @taketwoacting

Thank you!

Schauspielersuche:
Für den Kurzfilm "AT : Es stand Alles im Wahlprogramm"
sind folgende Rollen zu besetzen 

- Arabisch /Türkischer Mann ca. 20 Jahre alt
-Arabisch / Türkischer Mann ca 50 - 60 Jahre alt
- Deutscher Mann ca. 27 Jahre alt
-Arabisch / Türkische Frau ca. 27 Jahre alt
- Deutscher Mann ca 45 Jahre alt
- Deutsche Frau, blond, ca 45 Jahre alt

Filminhalt :
Ein rechtradikaler Politiker sonnt sich nach einer Wahl  in seinem Erfolg.
Aber die Fassade bröckelt. Eine bittere  Politsatire. 

Aufgrund des aktuellen Bezuges sollte der Dreh schnell erfolgen, daher kann jeder Schauspieler seine Rolle am Laptop oder Smartphone selber Filmen. 
Der Film soll dann kostenfrei auf you Tube gestellt werden und jeder kann den Film sofort nutzen. Es geht darum den Film zu verbreiten, daher auch leider keine Bezahlung,  da kein Geld verdient werden kann. 
Ich hoffe es finden sich Schauspieler, die sich gegen den Rechtsradikalismus stellen und Charakter zeigen.

Ich bin Thomas Goersch,  Schauspieler und Filmregisseur www.imdb.com/name/nm1591928
Meldet Euch unter Thomas.Goersch@vodafonemail.de 
Bis dann
Thomas

SEEKING ACTORS FOR STUDENT FILM
Title: Sabotage

Genre: Action Drama

Director: Annabelle Clement

Producer: Leo Callanen

Production Type: Student Short Film

🎥🎬🎞️📽️

Logline: When talented up and coming boxer Jade Mercer’s title is challenged by a close friend, the two fighters find themselves navigating personal betrayal and doping scandals in a grisly battle for dominance in their local underground tournament. 

Synopsis: Sabotage follows a pair of underground fighters who find themselves facing each other in the ring for the first time, neither of whom are happy. Jade, the current reigning champion, fears the rift that may grow between herself and her friend should she win. Maya, the

underdog, fears the embarrassment of losing to a close friend. As the match between the two

approaches, Maya is offered a mysterious performance enhancing substance by the girls’ Coach Sean. With the introduction of these drugs, the dynamic in the ring flips on its head. Maya, taking Jade down in dramatic fashion, strips her friend of the title. This defeat sends an injured Jade on a quest to rebuild herself and her reputation in hopes of reclaiming her title. One year later, she faces Maya in a match that will decide much more than the winner of the tournament.

LEAD ROLES 🩸

Jade Mercer: Early 20’s. Jade is extremely talented in the ring, the shining star of the underground, and a fan favorite. Jade works hard and gets results, always raising the bar for herself. Despite her intensity in the ring, she’s quite caring outside of it. 

Maya Mitchell: Early 20’s. Maya may not possess the same natural talent as Jade, but she’s every bit her equal when it comes to drive and commitment. Frustrated with her skill level, she’s determined to progress in the sport by any means possible. 

Coach Sean: Late 30’s. Sean is a retired professional boxer and current coach to Maya and Jade. Gruff, hypermasculine, and corrupt; Sean frequents the betting tables at competitions. 

ADDITIONAL ROLES 🎤

Emcee: High-energy, dramatic boxing announcer. Open to adults of all genders.

Tournament Employees: Young, nervous, eager. Open to young adults of all genders.

Referee: Stoic, sharp, rule-enforcer that doesn’t mind looking the other way. Open to mature adults of all genders.

Judges Panel: Mysterious, judgemental, and corrupt. Open to mature adults of all genders.

Extras: 

We are also seeking adults of all genders for our crowd scenes! Please fill out the interest form and select that you’re interested in being an extra.

Contact: peliculas.sin.leche@gmail.com

Run time: 12 minutes

Compensation: Unpaid; Crafty and meals provided.

Union status: Non-Union

Auditions: Please fill out our interest form, which you can access here (https://linktr.ee/peliculas.sin.leche), where you can also access our sides. Please submit self-tapes via our interest form. 

Please contact peliculas.sin.leche@gmail.com if you have any questions! 

Shooting schedule: We are planning to film November 7th, 8th, 14th, and 15th, exact schedules will be sent out ahead of shooting!

Location: Auraria Campus and Downtown Denver

Thanks everyone, I look forward to hearing from you!

topComments.text: You look stunning!  Auditioned for a movie so waiting the verdict!    If you get a minute check out my books.  I'm an actor, author, and screenwriter working on getting a movie version from my recent book. I'm very loyal to my readers and writers, and actors so let me know if you read,  My first book was optioned for a movie and Adam Sandler had the script for several months so thought he was going to do it but in the end, it did not happen.   Oscar winner Mel Brooks and an actor from Friends not only have blurbs in my quirky memoir but are in it! Hi everyone — posting on behalf of Title Productions Ltd in Bolton.

We're launching a YouTube documentary channel covering financial fraud, heists, and corporate collapse, produced to a cinematic standard.

We're looking for a presenter. One session per month, couple of hours, batch filming. Full scripts, teleprompter, all production support. £250 per session, monthly ongoing.

The persona is set to be calm, dry, and intelligent — not high energy, not broadcast news. Someone who can hold a camera with stillness and let an extraordinary story do the work.

We're looking to cast someone between the age of 20 and 30, but are willing to consider all ages that apply.  

To apply, just send a 60-second video to paul@titleproltd.com along with a headshot and general showreel link. 

Tell us who you are and why this sounds like your kind of project.    

Recording will take place at our studio in Bolton within the next couple of months.  Exact dates still to be determined as soon as casting is finalised.

Unfortunetely, travel & Accommodation will not be covered for this project, so please consider this when looking at the payment, your distance to travel and your costs getting to us.

Any more questions, contact Paul at paul@titleproltd.com

Thanks for looking

CASTING – SILHOUETTE PARLANTE – FEMME SENIOR

Dans le cadre du tournage d’un film interne pour Coopérative U, nous recherchons une comédienne pour interpréter le rôle d’Huguette.

PROFIL RECHERCHÉ

Femme entre 60 et 70 ans environ, au profil naturel, chaleureux et sympathique.
Nous recherchons une personne à l’aise devant la caméra et dans le jeu, capable d’incarner une cliente habituée de son super marché, spontanée et expressive.

LE RÔLE

Huguette est une cliente habituée de son Super U. Comme chaque lundi, elle vient faire ses courses de la semaine, avec cette fois-ci une mission particulière : trouver les ingrédients parfaits pour préparer le pot-au-feu d’anniversaire de sa fille.
Au cours de ses achats, elle découvre les offres digitales de la Carte U et se fait accompagner par un employé du magasin pour installer et prendre en main l’application.
L’histoire étant principalement racontée en voix off, le rôle repose essentiellement sur le jeu et les réactions d’Huguette, avec quelques interactions parlées à l’image.

INFORMATIONS TOURNAGE

Date : à partir de fin octobre
Lieu : Super U de Beaucouzé (départ de Paris, billet de train pris en charge)
Durée : 1 journée de tournage

RÉMUNÉRATION

Rôle : silhouette parlante
Rémunération totale : 300 €
175 € de salaire brut + 125 € de droits (pas de diffusion, communication interne uniquement)

Défraiement : train pris en charge à partir de Angers, Nantes, Le Mans, Tours ou Rennes

CANDIDATURE

Merci d’envoyer à l’adresse mail suivante : 

casting.playmaker@outlook.fr

des photos récentes (portrait et plein pied) ;
votre âge ;
votre ville de résidence ;
vos coordonnées ;
une courte vidéo de présentation et une bande démo.

Aspiring/Beginner Actors: Are you looking for some screen acting guidance and mentorship?🎬🌟

Hi, I’m Emma! I’m an Actress and Screen Acting Mentor based in the UK, and I am the founder of Take Two Acting. I have been involved in many productions for companies such as the BBC, Channel 4, Manchester Film School, SAE Liverpool and more.

I also work alongside another actor, Elena Pitsiaeli, who is known for “The Little Big Things” on the West End, CBBC’s Horrible Histories and many others!

The aim of the sessions is to give guidance on beginner screen actors who want tips on screen acting techniques and feedback on auditions, self tapes or monologues! Our sessions are casual and informal, and are completely tailored to the individual and their level.

All our lessons are online so open to actors from around the world! 

Before booking a session, we offer a FREE 10 min consultation, either by video call or phone. This is an opportunity for us to meet and discuss what you would want out of a session, and how we can best help you.

If you decide after the consultation you would like to book an online session, this can be arranged at a time that suits you!

Please message me if you’re interested in booking a free consultation, or simply want to know more about how we can help you☺️

Instagram: @taketwoacting

Thank you!

Monstrous Reflections my first feature film is now in pre-production with the aim to start filming early 2027. If you like truly dark, British gritty thrillers based in the extremes of social realism then this is the film for you. I will be aiming to start the casting process at the end of October for those who want to portray a role in this film. 

I am not certain at this time whether roles will be paid or a profit percentage offered instead. This will all come down to final funding. Either way, this film will be made regardless of final funds, teamwork makes the dream work and profits will be shared equally with everyone involved. 

Anyone who is interested please first check out the short concept film that heavily influences this feature. You will get an idea of what direction this feature film is going in and the style. 

During the casting process, actors will be asked about the short concept film, what they feel they could bring to the roles in this style of dark, psychological gritty thriller. 

You can check it out on YouTube now for free. I'll post a link in the comments below 👇.

items.text:
Hey everyone,

Would love some feedback. I signed my child with Zuri Miami, and they were keeping my child relatively busy. Even got self tape requests from big brands.. looking back, I realized I made a huge mistake switching over to a smaller exclusive kids agency. I didn’t know than what I know now, and assumed a smaller agency would be amazing and very personalized. Instead, this smaller agency basically never responded to my emails once we were signed. I was warned previously that this agency tends to sign kids to block talent (but was hoping it was just internet rumors), even saw an agent post about that too and sadly from my experience it feels like it’s true. 

All that to ask, how do you guys think agency’s take it when you reach back out wanting to sign with them again after leaving? We exited with no issues, and everyone was always so kind at Zuri and said they were sad to see my child leave.. but just curious your experience and or thoughts on trying to sign back with an agency? I don’t think I realized how good we had it with Zuri 😞

Für ein schwedisches Spielfilm-Projekt an der Filmakademie Stockholm suchen wir Besetzungen für zwei Rollen. Der Dreh findet am **Dienstag, den 22. September** in Wien statt.

**Gesuchte Rollen**
* **Kellner / Kellnerin** (männlich oder weiblich)
   * **Rollenart:** Kleindarsteller / Statist
   * **Drehzeit:** Dienstag, 22. Sept. – vormittags
* **Dr. Aichhorn** (männlich, ab 50 Jahren)
   * **Rollenart:** Sprechrolle (Kleindarsteller)
   * **Drehzeit:** Dienstag, 22. Sept. – nachmittags (ca. 16:30 – 19:00 Uhr)

Da es sich um eine unabhängige studentische Produktion ohne Budget handelt, können die Rollen leider nicht vergütet werden.

Wir bieten selbstverständlich einen Credit im Abspann, sowie Verpflegung am Set.

Bei Interesse senden Sie bitte ein aktuelles Foto (und ggf. Kontaktdaten) unter Angabe der gewünschten Rolle an **hello@felixgreisinger.com**.

## 🔥 SUCHE NEUE HERAUSFORDERUNG!

Ich kann nicht nur **eine Sache** – und genau das ist meine Stärke.

🎤 Entertainment & Moderation
📻 Radio & TV
📸 Foto, Video & Social Media
🎨 Mediengestaltung & Marketing

items.text:
Aspiring/Beginner Actors: Are you looking for some screen acting guidance and mentorship?🎬🌟

Hi, I’m Emma! I’m an Actress and Screen Acting Mentor based in the UK, and I am the founder of Take Two Acting. I have been involved in many productions for companies such as the BBC, Channel 4, Manchester Film School, SAE Liverpool and more.

I also work alongside another actor, Elena Pitsiaeli, who is known for “The Little Big Things” on the West End, CBBC’s Horrible Histories and many others!

The aim of the sessions is to give guidance on beginner screen actors who want tips on screen acting techniques and feedback on auditions, self tapes or monologues! Our sessions are casual and informal, and are completely tailored to the individual and their level.

All our lessons are online so open to actors from around the world! 

Before booking a session, we offer a FREE 10 min consultation, either by video call or phone. This is an opportunity for us to meet and discuss what you would want out of a session, and how we can best help you.

If you decide after the consultation you would like to book an online session, this can be arranged at a time that suits you!

Please message me if you’re interested in booking a free consultation, or simply want to know more about how we can help you☺️

Instagram: @taketwoacting

Thank you!

We are so excited to announce our **Director-Led Acting Workshop with Greg Francis** on 1st October for emerging actors! 🎬

This is your chance to step into the room with a working director. Greg is a film and music video director, and his work includes the award-winning short film *1Up* and videos for Dizzee Rascal and Little Mix. You'll be on your feet, working through practical exercises, learning how to respond to direction and getting direct, professional feedback. It's perfect for anyone looking to sharpen up their skills.

**Get ready to shine!** ✨ We'll send you a script a few days before the workshop to prepare, so all you need to do is learn it and bring it to life. No need to find your own material or a scene partner.

It's fully funded by ARSGO, and places are very limited. They're given on a first come, first served basis, so grab yours quickly before they run out! 🏃‍♀️

**Details:**
* 📅 Date: Thursday 1st October 2026
* ⏰ Time: 2:00pm – 5:00pm
* 📍 Location: Poplar Union, London

**Reserve your place:** [https://www.actorsreadysetgo.co.uk/director-training](https://www.actorsreadysetgo.co.uk/director-training)

NOW CASTING — Vancouver, BC

Project: "What Training Does To Your Body (Ages 1–100)"

For: Jeremy Ethier's YouTube channel (7.9M subscribers)

We're casting real people across a wide age range for a video comparing trained lifters vs. untrained beginner people across a lifetime — real body composition and performance testing, not just talk.

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR:

• Ages 10–13 (male, parent/guardian approval required)

• Ages 30–35 (trained & untrained, any gender)

• Ages 50–59 (all fitness levels — including health-journey stories)

• Ages 70–79 (lifelong lifters and total beginners alike)

• Ages 95–100 (active seniors — message me directly about this one)

DETAILS:

📍 Filming in Vancouver, BC

🗓️ Apply by September 20

💰 Not a paid role, but we cover a small honorarium/gift, your travel, and all medical scan/testing fees

📋 Process: short intake questionnaire → screening → scheduling

No acting experience necessary — we're looking for real people, real stories.

👉 Apply here: forms.gle/5vW3rmRmpeeSMqrJ7

Questions? Comment below or email stephanieco@builtwithscience.com

Channel: youtube.com/@JeremyEthier

items.text:
**Casting Call - Paid, Non-Union 4 day shoot**

**Project:** Tourism Fall Video Shoot

**Details: **Paid 4 day shoot in the Okanagan, 13th-16th Oct with paid travel day either side

**Day rate:** $700-$1100 depending on experience

**Role: **We’re casting two people to play a couple in their 50s travelling for a relaxed, premium weekend exploring the Okanagan Valley. This will be a 3-4 minute video for youtube and social media. Welcoming real life couples, friends, or individuals we can pair! 

This will mostly be unscripted with conversation prompts over meals, wine tastings, spa visits etc, so we are looking for individuals to spark off each other, deliver good anecdotes, make observations and have occasional moments of sincerity.  Looking for people who:
* Curious about food, wine, travel and the people they meet
* Enjoy an active lifestyle
* Comfortable cycling recreationally and a cold plunge
* Relaxed and a natural charisma on camera
* Take pride in their style

Previous acting experience is useful but not essential if the personalities are right. Welcoming comedic performers, improvisers, presenters, writers, athletes, foodies or people with interesting life experience could all be appropriate. Welcome submissions from all ethnicities. 

This will be a fun one, with tonal references of the 'The Trip'.

For more information email your headshot and resume to georgia@weareskeletoncrew.ca

topComments.text: This sounds like a fun shoot! Too bad I have work starting on the 13th or i would I totally apply.
Sent

items.text:
For Theatre students who need more dance and fitness training…

This program will help fill the dance gap so you can show up confident on stage and in auditions.

Take class live in Mansfield, TX
Or try it online for 14 days

sharedPost.text:
You already know what it feels like when the music hits and you get to GO.

That’s the feeling I want training to have.

Not counting down minutes until the workout is over.

Dancing. Performing. Sweating. Learning choreography. Giving it everything you’ve got.

Fitness doesn’t have to pull you away from the thing you love.

For performers, it can look a whole lot more like performing.

That’s why I build my workouts this way.

items.text:
CASTING: Independent Action-Horror Short (PAID — Negotiable) (Denver/Englewood Area)
Casting two roles for ENTER DRAGONEVSKI, a dark, stylized action-horror short as the first in a film series (Mortal Kombat vibes):

LEAD COMBATANT/SERAPHINA (Ages 18–35): One actress plays every female antagonist—5 distinct squad members and a commander named Seraphina. Huge showcase for range.

SUPPORTING COMBATANT (Any Gender, 18–40): A recurring squad partner who enters the fights, throws down, and sells over-the-top fatalities.

REQUIREMENTS: No high-level stunt experience needed! Just high energy, physical commitment, and genuine excitement for screen fighting/genre work.

ABOUT THE PRODUCTION & EXPECTATIONS:

Vibe: A personal, ultra-low-budget indie project shot in a studio apartment. Small crew, raw energy, and direct collaboration.

Physical Expectations: Fun, high-intensity physical movement, floor work, taking safe falls/mats, and dramatic death/fatality reactions.

What’s Provided: Negotiable stipend, basic food/snacks/drinks on set, IMDb credit, and fight scene video footage for your reel once edited.

TIMELINE:

Submissions: Open now through 9/24

Auditions: Quick self-tapes

Shoot Window: 9/25 – 9/27 (Englewood area)

DM me with a headshot or photo and a quick note on your background/interest!

SUPPORTING COMBATANT (Any Gender, 18–40): A recurring squad partner who enters the fights, throws down, and sells over-the-top fatalities.

REQUIREMENTS: No high-level stunt experience needed! Just high energy, physical commitment, and genuine excitement for screen fighting/genre work.

ABOUT THE PRODUCTION & EXPECTATIONS:

Vibe: A personal, ultra-low-budget indie project shot in a studio apartment. Small crew, raw energy, and direct collaboration.

Physical Expectations: Fun, high-intensity physical movement, floor work, taking safe falls/mats, and dramatic death/fatality reactions.

What’s Provided: Negotiable stipend, basic food/snacks/drinks on set, IMDb credit, and fight scene video footage for your reel once edited.

TIMELINE:

Submissions: Open now through 9/24

Auditions: Quick self-tapes

Shoot Window: 9/25 – 9/27 (Englewood area)

DM me with a headshot or photo and a quick note on your background/interest!

**Casting Call - Don't Go Yet **

Logline/Genre - Don’t Go Yet is a short film and passion project of mine. It is a dark dramedy focused on a pair of best friends Adam and Connor. When Adam walks in on a failed suicide attempt by Connor, he persuades him to give twenty-four hours to convince him life is worth living. If he fails, Connor may go through with the suicide with no interruption.

Dates and Locations – Dates have been nailed down but we are aiming for two to three weekends of shooting at the end of October/beginning of November. Locations are close to being locked in with one in Wheat Ridge and the other in Westminster.

Director – Cody Pape

Director of Photography – Alex Sistare

Compensation – The two leads will be paid $150 - $200 a day. Rest of the cast will be unpaid. Snacks and meals will be provided on all shoot days. You’ll also receive credit for the film.

Union Status – Non-union

Audition information - If interested please email [ctpape19@gmail.com](mailto:ctpape19@gmail.com) with the subject line “Don’t Go Yet – Your Name” with head shots, reels and any other applicable material and I will send sides in response. Once we have dates locked, we plan to hold in-person auditions for the two leads and most of the supporting cast.

Project Notes –** **Please note that this project contains heavy drug use and acts of suicide and self-harm.

**Characters**

Connor – Lead – late 20’s to early 30s male (any race) – A scrawny, handsome but unkept male that has lost all excitement about life. A small number of tattoos is preferred but not a requirement. He was once a very loving, outgoing person loved by many before everyone around him started to grow up. He refuses to make changes in his life due to the effort required to make them. Contact with close friends has depleted and he hasn’t been on a date in years. The only consistent thing in his life that brings him genuine joy is his best friend, Adam. He’s not miserable but he’s not happy. He’s done with the monotony of existing.

Preferred skills:
* Experience with instruments, specifically drums and/or guitar.
* Stunt work is required for this role. Suicide attempt by hanging, plastic bag over the head and prat falls are included in this role.
* Knowledge of hardcore and heavier music.

Adam – Lead – late 20’s to early 30s male (any race) - Adam is an average height; muscular man covered in tattoos with a smile they would use in a toothpaste advertisement. It's not mentioned that he is ex-military, but his appearance would suggest he served. He has a handful of extremely close relationships with men in his life but dates a new woman every month. He is the epitome of toxic masculinity and has no idea how to express himself. All feelings and emotions are under lock and key except when it comes to Connor who has access at times.

Preferred skills:
* Experience with instruments, specifically drums and/or guitar.
* Stunt work is required for this role. Suicide attempt by hanging.
* Knowledge of hardcore and heavier music.

Alec – Supporting – late 20’s to early 30s male (any race) – College buddy of Connor’s. Smaller in size. Timid and has trouble sticking up for himself. Is always in the circle but has trouble getting a word in.

Amanda – Supporting – late 20’s to early 30s female (any race) – A mutual friend of Adam and Connor’s. What once was an extremely important platonic friendship for Connor who could come to Amanda with any problem and get the support needed has become something distant to the point that Amanda has given up on the friendship. She is energetic, bubbly and can be a little bit of a steamroller in conversation. She finds it easy to give relationship advice but can’t figure out why she hasn’t found Mr. Right yet.

Gabe – Supporting - late 20’s to early 30s male or female (any race) – Connor and Adam’s old guitar player in a band that was taking off before Connor decided to self-sabotage the success. Gabe doesn’t hold any resentment. He lives in the moment at all times and couldn’t bother himself with what happened yesterday or the events of tomorrow.

Preferred skills:
* Experience with instruments, specifically drums and/or guitar.
* Knowledge of hardcore and heavier music.

Greg – Supporting – late 20’s to early 30s male (any race) – A high school friend of Connor and Adam’s. The starting quarterback that had all eyes on him on and off the field has had trouble accepting that time of his life is no longer around. He doesn’t have a lot going on upstairs. He assumed his body would take him places until laziness and beer took that from him. He is large and in charge in conversation and physical appearance. He picks on those smaller than him, projecting his own pain but is also quite oblivious to anyone’s feelings but his own.

Hailey – Supporting – late 20’s to early 30s female (any race) – Connor’s ex-girlfriend. To Connor, Hailey is the one that got away. They’re not together for many reasons but when they look at each other, there is an unspoken agreement that they will try again at some point. Hailey is the struggling artist that has it all figured out on the outside but due to past trauma can’t seem to give herself over to anyone once it becomes serious. Indie, alternative, mildly goth aesthetic. Piercings and tattoos are encouraged.

Tim – Supporting – late 20’s to early 30s male (any race) – Amanda’s new boyfriend that give’s Connor some perspective on life. Tim is a counterweight to Amanda’s energy and appears to be the answer to her prayers. You can tell they’re madly in love by the synchronicity of their laughter.

Vinny – Supporting - late 20’s to early 30s male (any race) – Singer or Guitar player of Adam and Connor’s old band. He was also Connor’s closest friend aside from Adam. He’s gone on with the band’s name with new members and is seeing the success that Connor always dreamed of. Both Connor and Vinny hold resentment towards each other. Vinny see’s Connor as wasted potential while Connor sees him as a sellout.

Preferred skills
* Experience with instruments, specifically drums and/or guitar.
* Knowledge of hardcore and heavier music.

Look forward to hearing from you!

Thanks!

sharedPost.text:
ATELIERS THÉÂTRE - ADULTES

Quand ?
Tous les samedis matins de 10h à 12h

Où ?
Au TNR, 3-5 rue Péan, 75013 Paris // Métro : Porte d’Ivry (Ligne 7)

Combien ?
180€ par trimestre + 10€ d’adhésion.
Il est possible d’avoir un tarif préférentiel selon votre coefficient familial (égal ou inférieur au QF4).

Le cours d’essai est gratuit !

Inscriptions, contactez Andréa : 06 32 07 69 48 // andrea.fulconis2@gmail.com

DESCRIPTIF

Le cours est ouvert à tous les adultes de 18 à 99 ans, désireux de rencontrer - ou de re-rencontrer - le théâtre.

- L’année sera divisée en deux parties - 

De septembre à décembre, nous travaillerons les outils du comédien par le biais d’exercices et d’improvisations (seul, à plusieurs, ou en collectif). Nous aborderons le corps et la voix de l’acteur, mais aussi son rapport à l’espace, à l’autre, au public, au silence... À travers cette recherche préliminaire, nous souderons le groupe. Le collectif sera notre maître-mot : c’est ensemble que l’on apprendra et que l’on grandira au plateau. L’objectif étant de monter une pièce ensemble durant la deuxième partie de l’année.

De janvier à juin, nous monterons, en effet, un spectacle à partir d’un texte d’auteur. Classique ou contemporain, comique ou tragique, nous trouverons l’auteur qui vous fait envie, la langue que vous voulez porter, l’histoire que vous voulez défendre ! Nous entamerons, alors, un travail précis d’interprétation du texte et de personnages, à travers une mise en scène crée sur mesure pour votre groupe. Un langage commun et une esthétique propre à la création nous rassemblera.

Plusieurs représentations sont prévues à la fin de l’année : nous jouerons notre pièce plusieurs fois devant un public bienveillant !

LA PROF - Andréa Fulconis

En parallèle d’un Master de Littérature Française à La Sorbonne, Andréa se forme aux Conservatoires d’Art Dramatique (CRD de Cannes, CRR de Nice et CRD de Bobigny). Puis, elle intègre l’École Internationale de Théâtre Jacques Lecoq, célèbre école de jeu corporel. Enfin, elle intègre la LUDI (Ligue Universitaire d’improvisation d’Île-de-France) et se perfectionne en improvisation.

Elle travaille, par la suite, pour plusieurs compagnies d’île-de-France en tant que comédienne, improvisatrice et metteuse en scène, comme Tonnerre de Singe, La Mazane ou Les Loups-Graou, qui sont tout autant d’espaces et des foyers de création lui permettant de développer sa recherche artistique.

La pédagogie prend également une place importante dans sa vie puisqu’elle est professeure de théâtre et d’improvisation pour la Cie Maya, la Ludo Impro’, La Mazane, et désormais au TNR, pour la Compagnie Tonnerre de Singe

Riche de toutes ces expériences, Andréa mêle, dans ses cours de théâtre, un travail précis de texte - hérité de sa formation classique - à une recherche vivante et corporelle, telle qu’elle s’en est emparée par la suite dans son travail artistique. Ses cours sont, pour elle, un espace de recherche à part entière, au même titre qu’une création professionnelle.

CASTING — NIKON FILM FESTIVAL
Bonjour à tous.tes ! Je suis à la recherche deux comédien.nes pour une comédie absurde de 2min20. 

PITCH 

Une balle de golf ricoche sur un drapeau, un arbre, puis rentre dans le trou en plein dans le mille. Salvatore D. Swing se retourne et regarde Stacy. Les trous en un l’impressionnent beaucoup moins qu’il y a 30 ans. Il va falloir tirer bien mieux que ça s’il veut sauver son couple.

LES RÔLES

SALVATORE D. SWING — 55 à 70 ans environ

Le meilleur golfeur de tous les temps. Salvatore est complètement obsédé par le golf. Il ne pense pratiquement qu’à ça, mais garde une attitude très décontractée lorsqu’il joue, comme si les exploits qu’il réalise étaient parfaitement ordinaires.

Point important : les dialogues de Salvatore ne seront pas en français.

Je recherche donc un acteur dont le français n’est pas la langue maternelle, et qui pourra interpréter ses dialogues dans sa langue natale. Aucune langue en particulier n’est recherchée : le choix se fera avant tout au coup de cœur et en fonction de la personnalité de l’acteur.

STACY — 55 à 70 ans environ

La compagne de Salvatore. Après des années passées à voir son mari consacrer toute son attention au golf, Stacy cherche à retrouver la complicité et la flamme des débuts de leur relation.

Pour ce personnage, je recherche une actrice avec une féminité très assumée et un style glamour, pouvant évoquer une esthétique de « bimbo » sophistiquée et légèrement artificielle : blonde platine, look très travaillé, apparence glamour, etc.

L’idée est d’assumer un personnage visuellement très marqué, mais avec une vraie personnalité et un potentiel comique derrière cette apparence.

INFORMATIONS

Tournage : début / mi-octobre 2026 (dates à confirmer)

Lieu : Île-de-France

Rémunération : projet non rémunéré, comédien·nes défrayé·es

Si le projet vous intéresse, merci d’envoyer votre profil à :

casting.gge@gmail.com

Merci beaucoup :)

Szukamy dzieci o etnicznej urodzie w wieku 5-17 lat oraz osoby do poszukiwania takich osób do odgrywania scenek na nagrania w Gdańsku lub w Warszawie.

1. Czas nagrania - 1 godzina. Termin i godziny do uzgodnienia. Nagrania są od poniedziałku do piątku.

2. Lokalizacja: Warszawa lub Gdańsk.

3. Zależy nam na dużej różnorodności etnicznej dzieci.

4. Wynagrodzenie za udział dziecka: 250 zł netto (płatne w ciągu 1 dnia po zleceniu — BLIK/konto bankowe).

5. Szukamy pilnie również osoby do szukania takich dzieci o etnicznej urodzie. Wynagrodzenie za znalezienie takiego dziecka, które zostanie zaangażowane do projektu — do uzgodnienia. Prosimy o wiadomość na adres e-mail rekrutacja@agencjainfernal.pl.

W razie zainteresowania prosimy o wysłanie zgłoszenia dziecka, podając następujące informację:

1. Imię i nazwisko

2. Rok urodzenia

3. Miasto zamieszkania

4. Telefon kontaktowy do rodzica

5. Adres e-mail do rodzica

6. Wzrost

7. Na jakie miasto jest wysyłane zgłoszenie dziecka? Na Gdańsk czy Warszawę? Czy na oba miasta?

7. Minimum jedno zdjęcie

Kontakt: rekrutacja@agencjainfernal.pl

W temacie wiadomości prosimy napisać: Nagrania-Scenki

Wysłanie zgłoszenie jest jednoznaczne z wyrażeniem zgody na przetwarzanie danych osobowych w celu udziału w projekcie zgodnie z Rozporządzeniem Parlamentu Europejskiego i Rady (UE) 2016/679 z dnia 27 kwietnia 2016 r. w sprawie ochrony osób fizycznych w związku z przetwarzaniem danych osobowych i w sprawie swobodnego przepływu takich danych oraz uchylenia dyrektywy 95/46/WE (ogólne rozporządzenie o ochronie danych). Administratorem Twoich danych osobowych pozyskanych w procesie rekrutacyjnym jest Agencja Artystyczna INFERNAL. Podanie danych jest dobrowolne, w każdej chwili przysługuje Ci prawo do wglądu do danych, ich poprawiania lub usunięcia. Kontakt do administratora rekrutacja@agencjainfernal.pl.

Do reklamy obiektu rekreacyjnego na **Jurze Krakowsko-Częstochowskiej** poszukujemy **6 osób** do udziału w nagraniu:

**3 kobiety i 3 mężczyzn**
**Wiek:** ok. 35–45/50 lat

Szukamy osób fotogenicznych, naturalnych i swobodnie czujących się przed kamerą.

Nagranie będzie miało charakter lifestyle’owo-biznesowy. Do odegrania będzie kilka prostych scen, bez wypowiedzi, m.in.: **spotkanie biznesowe w obiekcie, wspólne spędzanie wolnego czasu, korzystanie z atrakcji obiektu oraz wycieczka po Jurze Krakowsko-Częstochowskiej.**

**Termin:** 28.09.2026
**Miejsce:** Podlesice, woj. śląskie
**Godziny:** do ustalenia
**Wynagrodzenie:** 500 zł netto / osoba / dzień zdjęciowy

Prawdopodobnie potrzebne będą własne stylizacje – zarówno w charakterze biznesowym, jak i bardziej casualowym. Szczegóły ustalimy przed nagraniem.

**Zgłoszenia:**
Prosimy o przesłanie aktualnych zdjęć, krótkiego filmiku oraz kilku słów o sobie na adres: **[praca@goodeye.com.pl](mailto:praca@goodeye.com.pl)**

W tytule wiadomości prosimy wpisać: **„Casting biznes”**.

Zastrzegamy sobie kontakt z wybranymi osobami.

What can change in just a few hours underwater?

If you’re an actor, performer, model, or preparing for an underwater project, we help you become more natural, expressive and confident underwater — for the camera.

Our approach combines:

🎬 A Director’s Mindset

📷 A Photographer’s Eye

🌊 Two Generations of Underwater Filmmaking Experience

🎯 The ability to see what each individual needs — and know how to guide them there

We work on breath control, movement, body language, expression, confidence and performance for camera.

This is not swimming instruction.

This is not diving training.

This is Underwater Performance Coaching.

From “I don’t know what to do underwater” → to “I know how to perform underwater.”

LA Underwater Studio

Underwater Coaching for Actors & Performers

🎥 Jedno ujęcie. Bez cięcia. Kilkadziesiąt osób, precyzyjnie zaplanowany ruch kamery i ani jednego miejsca na przypadek.

Tak powstały sceny, które weszły do historii kina: otwierające ujęcie „Dotyku zła” Orsona Wellesa, słynne przejście przez kuchnię do klubu Copacabana w „Chłopcach z ferajny” Martina Scorsesego czy spektakularne długie ujęcia w „Ludzkich dzieciach” Alfonso Cuaróna.

Jak realizuje się takie długie ujęcie? Tego będzie można dowiedzieć się nie tylko z teorii.

🎬 3 powody, żeby dołączyć do naszego warsztatu:

👉 PRAKTYKA – uczestnicy zrealizują przygotowaną wcześniej scenę w długim ujęciu, pracując z systemem stabilizacji wybranym przez autora zdjęć.

👉 PROFESJONALNY SPRZĘT – w części technicznej będzie można poznać możliwości i zasady obsługi różnych urządzeń, m.in. gimbala i kranu kamerowego.

👉 TYLKO 12 MIEJSC – kameralna grupa oznacza realny udział w realizacji i możliwość przyjrzenia się pracy z kamerą z bliska.

📅 17–18 października 2026
🕙 10:00–18:00

🔞 16+
🎟 300 zł
